experiment: FlyGraph R53 syndrome-aware discrete multi-hypothesis ECC decoder
frozen_reasoning_stack: R35 verifier, beam width 32, edge expand 8

main.decoder: exact BSC codeword posterior over the frozen R52 ECC codebook
main.candidate_policy: for each noisy pointer retain 4 discrete codeword hypotheses; generate edge candidates from each clean codeword; score concrete trajectories with frozen R35 features computed on the original noisy pointer plus decoder branch prior; never average addresses or reasoning states

ablation: same ECC, same frozen R35 stack and decoder likelihood, but hard nearest-code decode (top-1) at every step
hyperparameter_provenance: top_k=4 and beta=0.10 were fixed implementation constants before final held-out seeds; a later exploratory calibration grid timed out and was discarded, with no result used for selection

excluded_incomplete.reason: timed out; produced no completed calibration result and did not select hyperparameters
timed out after id8/32/64 files; its partial 128 work was discarded. 128-hop was rerun as six standalone completed episodes.

success_criterion: 8-hop delta vs paired R52 ECC R35 >= -2pp; R53 strictly improves answer accuracy at both 64 and 128 hops over paired R52 ECC R35 and over hard-decode ablation.
semantic_validation: R52 v2 latest-write/target consistency check on every completed held episode
